In Edge, your default search engine is Bing, if you prefer to use Google as your search engine you can very easily change it – just follow these steps:

1. Open Edge and click on the ellipsis and go to settings:
![[Pasted image 20241231124922.png]]

2. Go to Privacy, Search and Services and scroll down to the Services Section, it will be towards the bottom.  Then select Address bar and search as shown below:
![[Pasted image 20241231125422.png]]

3. In the “Search engine used in the address bar” section, click the arrow and choose Google. 

Google will now be your default search engine.

When you open a new tab in Edge, you will have a search bar:

![](data:image/png;base64,)

As default, if you type something in here it will use Bing to search. 

You can change this to use your address bar to search and providing you have done the steps before, that will use Google to search!

 ![](data:image/png;base64,)
